---
title: "Patch main figure — boxplots (panels A–D)"
---

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| echo: false

pacman::p_load(patchwork, ggtext, install = FALSE)
```

## Introduction

Compose the boxplot panels (a–d) of the main figure: VAE boxplots (a–c) and UMAP boxplot (d).

## Load the data

```{r}

boxplot_list <- read_rds(
  here("VAE/lite/latent_coordinates/output/fig_tbl/boxplot_list_threshold_8.rds")
)

boxplot_list_umap <- read_rds(
  here("UMAP/lite/latent_coordinates/output/fig_tbl/boxplot_list_threshold_8.rds")
)

```

## Create a theme for the figure

```{r}
source(here("custom_func/theme_main_fig.R"))
set_pub_geom_defaults()
```

## Compose the boxplot figure

### Modify ggplot2 objects

```{r}

# Panel C: the three near-monotonic VAE dimensions named in the narrative (vae_6, vae_2, vae_4),
# stacked in a single column so the panel is tall and narrow. Derive them from the top-3 ANOVA
# ranks and assert their identity -- vae_N is not a stable axis across fits, so a hardcoded subset
# would silently show the wrong dimensions on a retrain.
progression_vae <- boxplot_list$one_dim_selected_1row
label_idx_c <- purrr::detect_index(progression_vae$layers, \(l) inherits(l$geom, "GeomText"))
stopifnot(label_idx_c > 0)
keep_c <- progression_vae$layers[[label_idx_c]]$data |>
  dplyr::arrange(p) |>
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 3) |>
  dplyr::pull(vae_dir) |>
  as.character()
stopifnot(
  "Fig 2c narrative names VAE_6/VAE_2/VAE_4; the top-3 ANOVA THR8 dimensions have changed" =
    setequal(keep_c, c("vae_6", "vae_2", "vae_4"))
)
progression_vae$data <- progression_vae$data |> dplyr::filter(vae_dir %in% keep_c) |> droplevels()
for (i in seq_along(progression_vae$layers)) {
  ld <- progression_vae$layers[[i]]$data
  if (!is.null(ld) && "vae_dir" %in% names(ld)) {
    progression_vae$layers[[i]]$data <- ld |> dplyr::filter(vae_dir %in% keep_c) |> droplevels()
  }
}
progression_vae <- progression_vae + facet_wrap(~vae_dir, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y")

boxplots_main <- lst(
  prev = boxplot_list$prev,
  stable_mci = boxplot_list$stable_mci,
  progression_vae = progression_vae
) |>
  map(~ .x + theme_main_fig() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = ggtext::element_markdown(angle = 30, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 0, b = 0, l = 0, r = 0)
  ))

# Rescale geom sizes for publication column width (10" → 6.5")
# Shift p-value text closer to y-axis
shift_pvalue_text <- function(p, x = 0.06) {
  for (i in seq_along(p$layers)) {
    ap <- p$layers[[i]]$aes_params
    if (inherits(p$layers[[i]]$geom, "GeomText") &&
        identical(ap$colour, "darkred")) {
      p$layers[[i]]$aes_params$x <- I(x)
    }
  }
  p
}

boxplots_main <- boxplots_main |>
  map(~ rescale_layer_params(.x, size_scale = 0.5, linewidth_scale = 0.5, pt_scale = 0.8)) |>
  map(shift_pvalue_text)

panel_d <- boxplot_list_umap$one_dim_selected_1row +
  theme_main_fig() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = ggtext::element_markdown(angle = 30, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 0, b = 0, l = 0, r = 0)
  )
panel_d <- rescale_layer_params(panel_d, size_scale = 0.5, linewidth_scale = 0.5, pt_scale = 0.8)
panel_d <- shift_pvalue_text(panel_d)

```

### Compose with patchwork

```{r}
#| label: fig-vae-boxplots
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 12
#| fig-cap: "VAE and UMAP boxplots"

layout <- "
AAAAAAAACC
BBBBBBBBCC
DDDDDDDDCC
"

fig_vae_boxplots <-
  boxplots_main$prev +
  boxplots_main$stable_mci +
  free(boxplots_main$progression_vae) +
  free(panel_d) +
  plot_layout(design = layout, guides = "auto", axes = "keep", axis_titles = "keep",
              widths = c(1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1.5, 1.5)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")

fig_vae_boxplots

fs::dir_create(here("VAE_UMAP_comb/patch_figures/output"))

png(here("VAE_UMAP_comb/patch_figures/output/fig_vae_boxplots.png"),
    width = 6.5, height = 6, units = "in", res = 600)
fig_vae_boxplots
dev.off()
```

## Verify output

```{r}
fs::file_info(here("VAE_UMAP_comb/patch_figures/output/fig_vae_boxplots.png")) |>
```
